headline: Lunaris carry boost
title: Lunaris | Antigravity Adds Carry Weight | Palworld Guide
video_script: Need more carrying capacity in Palworld one point zero? Lunaris is a Neutral Pal whose partner skill, Antigravity, makes Pal Spheres home in on Pals and raises your carrying capacity by three hundred to six hundred while it is in your party. At base it works Handiwork level four, plus Gathering and Transporting at level two. Will you carry Lunaris? Comment below!
description: Lunaris in Palworld 1.0 is a Neutral Pal with Handiwork level four and an Antigravity carry weight bonus.
